nodes.notes: Enable after selecting your Telegram bot credential and setting the chat ID.

nodes.name: Draft Abuse Report (Gmail)
nodes.notes: Enable after connecting Gmail. Creates a DRAFT only - a human reviews before sending.

parameters.content:
## BrandGuard automation layer

1. BrandGuard app POSTs scan findings here.
2. 'Build Report' formats an alert + a platform abuse report.
3. App gets an instant JSON reply.
4. If critical/high: Telegram alert + Gmail DRAFT (enable these two after adding credentials).

Reports are drafts for human review - nothing is sent automatically.
